title: Koh Samet: taps and targets
kaylee: Walk into a pink ring and the toy starts. Hold a finger on anything and she follows it; a quick tap still pokes it. The snorkel boat is in view from the sand, and the bin takes the bottle. My call: the boat moved in beside the jetty so she can see it, and rings don't start a toy while she's carrying rubbish or has the phone out.
